Name: Sandy Dialogue Expansion
Author: Godvid
Description:
[b][size=4]About this Mod / Sobre este Mod[/size][/b]
Sandy is one of the most charming characters in Stardew Valley, but she often feels a bit "unfinished." This mod aims to give her the depth she deserves with a complete overhaul of her interactions.
and I know she is going to be a marriage candidate in the upcoming version but i cant wait more to have some more of sandy.
The mod was created with human ideas and implemented with AI (since I have no idea how to program mods and this is the first one I've made).

[b]I'd love to hear all your opinions about the mod ! [/b]

Sandy es uno de los personajes más encantadores de Stardew Valley, pero a veces se siente un poco "incompleta". Este mod busca darle la profundidad que merece renovando sus interacciones por completo.
y se que ella va a ser una nueva candidata en la proxima versión del juego pero no podía esperar más para tener algo de sandy.
El mod se ha realizado con ideas humanas y ha sido implementado con IA (ya que no tengo ni idea de programar mods y este es el primero que hago).

[b]Me encantaria conocer vuestra opinión sobre este mod ! [/b]

[size=4][b]Main Features / Características Principales[/b][/size]
80+ New Dialogue Lines: Fresh conversations for every day, weather changes, and seasons.

Progression Mail System: Receive 8 unique letters from Sandy as your friendship grows, including desert-themed gifts. (not all the letters have gifts) 

Dynamic Reactions: She will react to your marriage, your friendship with Pam/Emily, and even some of your polyamorous relationships.

SVE Support: Special dialogues included for Stardew Valley Expanded

Bilingual: Full support for English and Spanish.
[b]
[size=4]Installation / Instalación[/size][/b]
Install SMAPI: The essential mod loader.

Install Content Patcher: Required for this mod to work.

Download this mod: Extract the .zip file.

Place the folder: Move the [CP] Sandy dialogue folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory. 

Run the game: Launch via SMAPI and enjoy!
[b]
[size=4]Compatibility & Recommendations[/size][/b]
[size=3]you need Content patcher.[/size]
[!IMPORTANT]
Marriage Note: This mod adds dialogue for when you are married to Sandy, but it does not allow you to marry her by itself. You will need a separate mod (like Looking for Love or Romanceable Sandy) to enable the marriage.

Polyamory: I highly recommend using this with a polyamory mod, as I've included specific lines for those unique situations!

Stardew Valley Expanded: Fully compatible and recommended for the extra immersion.

if you see bugs report them and i will try to solve them

[b][size=4]Shout outs / Créditos[/size][/b]
Special thanks to the community and the power of AI collaboration, which allowed me to bring this project to life and manage the technical side without prior modding knowledge.
